channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rick Carlisle | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rick Carlisle from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Tyrese Haliburton on Rick Carlisle:

“Yeah, I think he is a very super serious person. I try to joke as much as I can to get him to crack a smile or laugh from time to time. During playoff time, it’s hard. If I can get him to smile or laugh during the playoffs, it’s a pretty special moment for me—it’s something I cherish. He’s the guy who’s always setting the tone with his sternness and seriousness. And I feel like it’s kind of my job—you know, I’m the point guard—so I’ve got to be the coach on the floor to share that messaging. But at the same time, I’ve got to keep everybody loose and having fun. Let them know: it’s just basketball. So let’s just go out there and hoop.”

Tyrese Haliburton on Rick Carlisle, May 15, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Mark Daigneault on Rick Carlisle:

“He's forgotten more about the NBA than anyone else knows in the first place.”

Mark Daigneault on Rick Carlisle, Mar 29, 2025. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Steven Adams on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
“Threw my name in the NBA draft -- averaged 6 and 6, and yeah, went number 12, bro... I was just there for the ride. I had no expectations of even making the NBA.[Rick] Carlisle was the only one brutally honest with me, 'You average 6 and 6, why'd you come out of college,'”

Steven Adams on Rick Carlisle, Aug 20, 2023. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: George Karl on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
“Rick Carlisle (the Pacers’ coach and the president of the NBA Coaches Association) does a nice job of keeping my spirits up,”

George Karl on Rick Carlisle, Sep 9, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Pritchard told Fieldhouse Files.

“But look, Larry is a good friend of mine and he’s a good friend of Rick’s (Carlisle). At any time we need help, we know where to look. He’s always available.”

Kevin Pritchard on Rick Carlisle, Jul 25, 2022. Source: Fieldhouse Files.

item.title: Brendan Haywood on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Dwain Price:Brendan Haywood on the Mavs' future:

“They have one of the best owners. They have a very good front office who are going to put good players around you. They have one of the best coaches in the league in Rick Carlisle, and they have two of the best young players in the league.”

Brendan Haywood on Rick Carlisle, Aug 21, 2020. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Porzingis on his talks with Carlisle:

“I also tell him, 'I’ve got to be better, I've got to play better.' It's not only the position that I’m in, I've got to be more effective and more consistent. I’ve had some good games and not so good. I'm looking forward to bouncing back.”

Kristaps Porzingis on Rick Carlisle, Nov 13, 2019. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
While laughing,Doc Rivers on playing against Carlisle:

“Actually, he was never hard to play against when I was a player. That was very easy.”

Doc Rivers on Rick Carlisle, Oct 18, 2019. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
“When you’re in coach (Rick Carlisle’s) system the (center position) has a great roll presence, a great rim presence on both ends. “And there’s obviously not a lot (of centers) that are better at that – he might even be the best at that in the league. He’s a runner, he’s a rim protector, he’s a roller, he finishes as high above the rim as anyone, so we’re really looking forward to start working with him.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Rick Carlisle, Aug 9, 2018. Source: mavs.com.

item.title: Nerlens Noel on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
“Coach Carlisle is a good guy and a family man. He definitely understands me like I understand him. We’ve never had any type of conflict because at the end of the day we really understand each other for the most part,”

Nerlens Noel on Rick Carlisle, Mar 15, 2018. Source: mavs.com.

item.title: Fred Hoiberg on Luke Walton, Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Vincent Goodwill:Fred Hoiberg on Rick Carlisle’s words:

“I think it’s great. Rick as the president of the coaches association, sticking up for a fellow coach. Knowing Luke Walton... I think he’s a hell of a coach and he’s doing a great job.”

Fred Hoiberg on Luke Walton, Rick Carlisle, Jan 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @vgoodwill.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Rick Carlisle, LaVar Ball
item.description:
“I don't see it because I don't look at it. I heard about it. Everybody's heard about it. To be honest with you, one word (about Ball's comments) is too many. I'm glad (Carlisle) did what he did, he represented the coaches. Luke does a great job in Los Angeles.”

Mike D'Antoni on Rick Carlisle, LaVar Ball, Jan 8, 2018. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Donnie Nelson, Rick Carlisle
item.description:
“I’ll be around for a while, and I’m sure we’ll meet with Mark and with Donnie. You know, [Mavs coach Rick Carlisle] will be here and even [leading scorer Harrison Barnes], and we’ll just see how we can help and how we can make this better. Maybe I’ll be in the draft room this year, if that’s what it takes. …I think we’ve got plenty of time over the next few weeks to set a plan, execute the plan on draft day hopefully and maybe in free agency, and we’ll go from there.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Donnie Nelson, Rick Carlisle, May 15, 2017. Source: mavs.com.

item.title: Nerlens Noel on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Nerlens Noel:

“I think this is a big offseason for me. I'll be looking to spend a lot of time with coach Carlisle.”

Nerlens Noel on Rick Carlisle, Apr 13, 2017. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Tony Romo on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Dwain Price:Tony Romo on Carlisle:

“It’ll be great to sit out here and yell at him a little bit about some of the play calls he makes tonight.”

Tony Romo on Rick Carlisle, Apr 11, 2017. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Harrison Barnes on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Dwain Price:Harrison Barnes on Rick Carlisle missing practice:

“Im sure he’ll watch practice on the cameras and have some comments tomorrow. He’s never out of reach.”

Harrison Barnes on Rick Carlisle, Jan 24, 2017. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Melvin Hunt on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Dwain Price:Melvin Hunt on coaching today for Rick Carlisle:

“I do not feel like a substitute teacher at all. They didn’t throw boogers at me and snot balls.”

Melvin Hunt on Rick Carlisle, Jan 24, 2017. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Justin Anderson on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:Justin Anderson on Rick Carlisle giving him playing time:

“He saw I was always ready to play within the system. He saw my approach in practice.”

Justin Anderson on Rick Carlisle, Aug 11, 2016. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: Jason Terry on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Calvin Watkins:Jason Terry on Rick Carlisle:

“Rick is a mastermind, a great ping pong player but also a chess player.”

Jason Terry on Rick Carlisle, Feb 4, 2016. Source: Twitter @calvinwatkins.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
“I actually put a bug in [Rick Carlisle's] ear a couple of times in the last couple of weeks about getting him more playing time.”

Mark Cuban on Rick Carlisle, Jan 24, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Metta World Peace on Steve Kerr, Gregg Popovich, Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Metta World Peace:

“The triangle [offense] is hard. It’s not easy. But there’s things you can implement. Everybody does that. Golden State and San Antonio does that. Golden State has Steve Kerr and they run a little bit of triangle. The Spurs run a little bit. [Gregg] Popovich reminds me of Phil and [Rick] Carlisle. He dictates a lot [of plays], but then he lets you go. Carlisle has his own style. Popovich has his own style. But he reminds me of Phil and Carlisle together.”

Metta World Peace on Steve Kerr, Gregg Popovich, Rick Carlisle, Dec 8, 2015. Source: Los Angeles Daily News.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Tim McMahon:Rajon Rondo on interrupting Rick Carlisle's huddle w/ Deron Williams:

“He just told me to get the f--- out of here. I’ve heard that before.”

Rajon Rondo on Rick Carlisle, Dec 1, 2015. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Dwain Price:Dirk Nowitzki on Rick Carlisle:

“He’ been the man here ever since he got here. He’s a great X’s and O’s guy.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Rick Carlisle, Oct 27, 2015. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Dwain Price:Dirk Nowitzki on Rick Carlisle:

“He’s great at making adjustments in series and during games. He’s obviously the right guy for this job.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Rick Carlisle, Oct 27, 2015. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Byron Scott on Rajon Rondo, Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Baxter Holmes:B. Scott on Rondo-Carlisle blow-up:

“When I saw it, I was like, whoa. That was different. Neither guy looked like they wanted to back down.”

Byron Scott on Rajon Rondo, Rick Carlisle, Apr 12, 2015. Source: Twitter @BaxterHolmes.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Rajon Rondo, Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Brian Robb:Ainge on Rondo-Carlisle incident:

“I know that Rondo is an emotional guy and feisty. None of it really surprises me.”

Danny Ainge on Rajon Rondo, Rick Carlisle, Feb 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @CelticsHub.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Dwain Price:Rondo on Carlisle:

“I like his honesty. He’s pretty straight forward. Rick and I have been talking non-stop daily, (sending) text messages.”

Rajon Rondo on Rick Carlisle, Jan 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: LeBron James on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Dwain Price:LeBron James:

“If it's not the top 3 or 4 best offenses in the league, then you don't get any better than Rick Carlisle's offense.”

LeBron James on Rick Carlisle, Oct 18, 2014. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Chandler Parsons on Rick Carlisle
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Parsons on Carlisle:

“He came to me as a man, and we have a great relationship. It's in the past, and we're going to move forward.”

Chandler Parsons on Rick Carlisle, Oct 13, 2014. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Chris Kaman on Mike D'Antoni, Rick Carlisle
item.description:
“Coach Carlisle is uptight and kind of plays games with people here and there. Coach D'Antoni is more relaxed. He lets guys get a feel and make mistakes and play. That's the kind of basketball players like to play. You can't micromanage every situation and pull a guy in and out and in and out. It just doesn't work that way. If you have some superstars, you might get away with that. But if you have guys who aren't superstars, it's hard to do that.”

Chris Kaman on Mike D'Antoni, Rick Carlisle, Nov 5, 2013. Source: Dallas Morning News.
